entities.name: Volver
entities.description: Mutant abominations resulting from the Rathi Overlay, synthesizing three colors of magic.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The merging of Rath with Dominaria that disrupted the natural flow of magic and caused mutations.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Volvers arose.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during whose darkest days Volvers were seen as an affirmation by wizards.

events.summary: When Rath overlays Dominaria, the merge disrupts magic and causes mutations, producing the Volvers.
events.quote: the Volvers are the result of one such mutation

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, disciples of enemy-color schools see the Volvers as an affirmation of their studies.
events.quote: saw these creatures as an affirmation of their studies
